title: Flow: free YouTube Premium alternative
caption:
YouTube Premium charges $15.99/month. Flow plays YouTube without ads for free 📺

✅ No ads, and it skips sponsor segments
✅ Background play, picture-in-picture and downloads
✅ Recommendations learned on your phone, no Google account
✅ No tracking, no sign-in, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Android
ℹ️ Android only. It's an unofficial YouTube client you install from GitHub as an APK, so it's not on the Play Store.

Comment "FLOW" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
